svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 150 mm lengths of 60 x 6 mm bar; square and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle slot: 10.2 mm wide on the centre line, 36 mm deep from the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end, flat bottom. The axle flats (10 mm) slide in from above and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its centre sits 120 mm above the board. Saw both sides, file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot bolt holes: two 6.6 mm, 20 mm up, 18 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The upright on the socket side of the motor (the one nearer the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge) also gets two 4.4 mm holes for the Hall bracket,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 mm up, 12 and 20 mm from centre toward the module.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: inside faces 135 mm apart (the motor's axle width); feet bolted

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the outside faces; axle nut and washer outside each upright.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the motor's axle drops into both slots by hand and cannot turn.
